Name: No Pond Standard Farm -Fixed-
Author: burgahboy
Description:
I love this mod https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1751/ just simply due to it removing ponds from your farm.  However, there was a small graphical error with it, underneath the trough was basically water.  I decided to fix this and just make it look good.  If BaconCatBug wants me to remove this, I will.

[b][color=#ff0000]SEASONAL IMMERSION:[/color][/b]
While making this, I found out that while in the winter, the trough would clip through the house, if you have season immersion, I have included an edited file of the house so this doesn't happen to you.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).

Downloads.Description: If you use seasonal immersion, put this in the contentpack.
